name: prism
description: A local AI workspace for reading and understanding research papers.

scripts.dev: tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.test:capture: npm run build && node scripts/test-capture.mjs && node scripts/test-curation.mjs && node scripts/test-knowledge-ai.mjs && node scripts/test-knowledge-graph.mjs && node scripts/test-knowledge-insights.mjs && node scripts/test-citations.mjs && node scripts/test-paper-digest.mjs && node scripts/test-note-contract.mjs && node scripts/test-codex-approval.mjs
scripts.test:notes-ui: npm run build && node scripts/test-vault-compatibility.mjs && node scripts/smoke-notes-ui.mjs
scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win portable --publish never
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --publish never
scripts.package:mac:x64: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:arm64: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.test:product: npm run build && node scripts/test-product-core.mjs && node scripts/test-product-ui.mjs
